task:
Implement both methods of `roman.RomanNumerals` in
`src/main/java/roman/RomanNumerals.java`. They currently throw
UnsupportedOperationException.

`toRoman(int n)` converts 1..3999 to standard subtractive notation
(4 -> "IV", 9 -> "IX", 40 -> "XL", 90 -> "XC", 400 -> "CD", 900 -> "CM")
and throws IllegalArgumentException outside that range.
`fromRoman(String s)` converts a string in that same standard form back
to an int and throws IllegalArgumentException for null, empty, lowercase,
unknown characters, or any string that is not the canonical form of a
number (for example "IIII", "VX", "IM"). `fromRoman(toRoman(n)) == n`
must hold for every n in range. Standard library only.
test_command: rm -rf out && javac -d out $(find src -name '*.java') && java -cp out roman.RomanNumeralsTest
acceptance_command: rm -rf out && javac -d out $(find src/main acceptance_tests -name '*.java') && java -cp out acceptance.AcceptanceTest
